title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Working on High Quality “AirPods”; KGI Securities
text:
February 25, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Working on High Quality “AirPods”; KGI Securities 
In a new report, an analyst Ming-Chi Kuo of KGI Securities says that, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is updating its wireless AirPods, and he noted the tech company is working on headphones being of high-quality, and expectedly could arrive later this year, according to Apple Insider. 
The report of KGI Securities says that Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) plans for the headphones to “be as convenient as AirPods with better sound quality,” and that they could arrive by the 4rth quarter this year. 
It also notes that the headphones are expected to be priced higher than AirPods, that would retail for $159. Earlier in last week Word broke says that Apple is planning a couple of upgrades to “AirPods” including the ability to activate Siri by voice this year, and making them water-resistant in 2019. 
If the report is accurate, it looks as though Apple is looking for high-end headphones of its own for customers who want more than the company’s AirPods. Apple delving into the world of high-quality headphones isn’t too strange: the company already owns a headphones company, Beats, which it bought in 2014 for $3 billion.
